title.narrative: Mainstreaming Sustainable Urbanization Through Trilateral South-South Cooperation

description.narrative:
This Umbrella Programme seeks to support subnational and national governments from the global south to take ownership of and implementing the urban SDG’s, adapting Brazilian proven experiences, frameworks and tools, especially those that were built with the support of UN-Habitat after 25 years of presence in the country.
This initiative will enhance capacities of local and national governments to formulate, implement and monitor policies, strategies and tools for responding to their urban challenges. It will rely on the engagement of Brazilian institutions, at national and subnational level, who have first-hand experience in tackling urban challenges. The Programme will rely as well as on the capacity of UN-Habitat to play a broker and a convener role in leveraging Brazilian institutions to support partner countries with new knowledge, better policies and tools to reinforce their urban development processes. It also aims to formulate and potentially implement concrete actions for sustainable urban development.
This Umbrella Programme will also foster the importance of taking into account the local context in order to adapt the methods and tools that will be offered, as well as benefiting from mutual understanding and exchange.
The Programme will be guided by the following: - Demand-driven approach - Solidarity and non-interference in partners’ domestic affairs, leading to practices of non-conditionality - Responding to the specific challenges of developing countries - Alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (SDCF) - Alignment with international, regional and national normative frameworks - Alignment with partner national plans and priorities and support for regional efforts and agreements - Long-term engagement and sustainability - Strengthening human, technical and institutional capacity development - Improving the exchange of experiences and know-how to achieve mutual benefits - Results-oriented planning, monitoring and impact assessment applicable to South-South cooperation
The Programme will be structured around the following objective and outcomes:
Objective: Enhance the implementation of the urban SDGs and the New Urban Agenda in the Global South - Outcome 1: Enhanced capacities of local and national governments partners in the Programme to design evidence-based urban policies and projects guided by the SDGs. - Outcome 2: SDG-oriented urban policies and practices following the principles of the New Urban Agenda accelerated in partner local and national governments NB: the possibility to develop and sign subprojects under this umbrella related to DoC1 (Reduced spatial inequality and poverty in communities across the urban - rural continuum), DoC2.3 (Expanded deployment of frontier technologies and innovations for urban development), DoC3.3 (Effective adaptation of communities and infrastructure to climate change) and DoC4.3 (Enhanced resilience of the built environment and infrastructure) - Outcome 3: Raised awareness for SDG-oriented sustainable urban development through Trilateral South-South Cooperation NB: activities related to communication and results dissemination to support the other outcomes.
